violet_marketing: Quick sync 	6am PT check before we push the Thursday announcement (target 10:30 PT). Need: final one-line headline, a single bench stat for the hero, the canonical docs URL, rollout start time confirmation, and sales tag validation. @matt_engineering @clara_docs @ignacio_product @sophia_salesops

matt_engineering: Rollout plan: start 09:00 PT with a 7% canary for 12m, then 40% for 18m, full by 10:00 PT if healthy. Watch error rate >0.5% or p95 up >20% -> pause. No infra holds.

clara_docs: Docs are staged at https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-7-staging. Will flip to /v2-7 on publish. Added migration steps and a short "compatibility notes" section. Copyable migration snippet for email:
```
{"runtime":{"quantization":"enable","preferred":"int8_adaptive"}}
```

ignacio_product: Bench highlight: internal chat trace shows up to 29% token cost reduction and median p95 down 15%. Recommend marketing wording: "reduces token cost by up to 30% on common chat workloads" with bench link. Also suggest a webinar CTA next Wed 11am PT.

violet_marketing: We'll use the "up to 30%" line (with bench link). Headline options: "v2.7: faster chats and lower token costs" or "Save up to 30% on chat inference with v2.7". Leaning to second for homepage hero. Need hero PNG and alt text.

sophia_salesops: Salesops: form will tag inbound leads with "launch_v2_7" and route to "inbound-launch" queue. I'll run a smoke test after the send. No blockers from my side.

ci-bot: Release pipeline triggered by matt_engineering at 1934999920. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/58100

matt_engineering: Perf PNG uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/v2-7-hero.png Alt: "cost and latency comparison v2.6 -> v2.7". CSV attached.

violet_marketing: Final checklist: headline (use second), bench stat (up to 30% with link), docs link (clara), migration snippet (include in email), hero image (matt), sales routing (sophia). Plan to send at 10:30 PT with a webinar CTA. Any objections?

matt_engineering: No objections. We'll monitor closely and post status.

ci-bot: Canary started at 1935000030. 7% canary running.

matt_engineering: Canary stable at 09:12 PT, moving to 40%. No regressions.

ci-bot: Full rollout completed at 1935000120. Status: success. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/58100/console

violet_marketing: LIVE  announcement sent at 10:30 PT. Sophia, please confirm tag smoke test when done. Thanks everyone! :tada:

sophia_salesops: Confirmed after-send test: leads tagged "launch_v2_7" and routed to "inbound-launch". All good.
